statement.zh: 学术综合常以矩形围场与网格规划建筑作为瓦里行省中心的建筑标志（Schreiber；Isbell & McEwan）。
statement.en: Syntheses often treat rectangular enclosures and orthogonal planning as architectural markers of Wari provincial centres (Schreiber; Isbell & McEwan).
